mapper.sql: rpt02_month_id AS month_id , rpt02_person_id AS person_id , rpt02_org_nm AS org_name , rpt02_yyyymm AS yyyy_mm , rpt02_content AS content , rpt02_note AS note , rpt02_file_count AS file_count

mapper.select:

WHERE 1=1
AND rpt02_org_id = #{orgCodeId}
AND UPPER(CONCAT(rpt02_org_nm, rpt02_content, rpt02_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY rpt02_org_cd, rpt02_yyyymm
